title: Tensor-based Fusion of Multi-modal Data for Predicting Cancer Risk Levels
abstract: arXiv:2610.13221v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cancer diagnosis and treatment increasingly rely on multi-modal diagnostic technologies that generate high-dimensional datasets. Although these datasets are rich in pathological information, they pose considerable challenges in interpretation, dimensionality reduction, and clinical applicability. Conventional machine learning approaches often fail to extract meaningful cross-modal features, thereby limiting predictive accuracy in patient risk stratification. To address these limitations, this paper proposes an unsupervised machine learning framework that integrates feature extraction, tensor decomposition, and clustering to improve cancer risk prediction. The framework employs tensor decomposition to fuse heterogeneous genomic and clinical data, enabling the extraction of latent, biologically meaningful features that outperform unimodal feature sets. translated_title: 基于张量的多模态数据融合用于预测癌症风险等级
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.13221v1 公告类型：新 摘要：癌症的诊断与治疗日益依赖于生成高维数据集的多模态诊断技术。尽管这些数据集蕴含丰富的病理信息，但它们在解释、降维和临床适用性方面带来了相当大的挑战。传统的机器学习方法往往无法提取有意义的跨模态特征，从而限制了患者风险分层中的预测准确性。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种无监督机器学习框架，该框架集成了特征提取、张量分解和聚类，以改进癌症风险预测。该框架采用张量分解来融合异构的基因组与临床数据，从而能够提取出优于单模态特征集的、具有生物学意义的潜在特征。本文研究了多种特征提取策略，所得特征……
tldr: 本文提出一种集成特征提取、张量分解与聚类的无监督机器学习框架，通过融合异构的基因组与临床多模态数据提取具有生物学意义的潜在特征，从而提升癌症风险等级预测的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an unsupervised machine learning framework integrating feature extraction, tensor decomposition, and clustering, which fuses heterogeneous genomic and clinical multi-modal data to extract latent biologically meaningful features, thereby improving cancer risk level prediction.
